# BEACN NFT Studio

Public app: https://beacnpool.github.io/NFT-Studio/
Open source: https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio
Cardano knowledge: https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio/tree/main/knowledge
MCP documentation: https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio/blob/main/docs/MCP.md

## Public MCP

Endpoint: https://beacn-nft-studio.davidmjensen17.chatgpt.site/api/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP. Authentication: none.
Tools: studio_capabilities, search_knowledge, read_knowledge, validate_payload,
create_mint_intent, verify_mint_intent, create_proof_record, verify_proof_record,
prepare_unsigned_transaction.

Begin with studio_capabilities for current limits and evidence boundaries.
File inputs contain explicit canonical base64 bytes, never local paths or URLs.
The public service receives supplied content; do not supply secrets.
For a mint, save create_mint_intent.packetJson as its suggested filename and
return review.url to the human. The human imports it in Labs / Agent minting,
inspects exact files and approves any transaction in their own wallet.
prepare_unsigned_transaction receives an explicitly authorized CIP-30 change
address and UTxO snapshot and builds native NFT/data unsigned CBOR. The snapshot
is disclosed to the service; it does not prove wallet ownership or unspent chain
state. There is no packet ID or retained preparation. An external signer must
independently check the complete signed transaction and current inputs.
No public tool signs, submits or connects to a wallet.

## Evidence boundaries

CIP proposal status and Studio implementation evidence are separate.
Hashes verify exact bytes, not authorship, ownership, rights or chain inclusion.
State capsules are experimental contracts; the browser demonstration is local.
Proof records use the public hash profile of proposed CIP-190; export is not
publication or a blockchain timestamp.
The separately installed Node MCP can prepare unsigned transactions and verify
external signatures. It never holds a signing key or submits a transaction.
